IDENTITY: A small adult fluffy mixed-breed companion dog. Rust-gold/ginger tan body, distinctive darker sable center stripe on crown and forehead, charcoal-brown muzzle fading naturally into tan cheek pads, black dog nose, warm BROWN eyes, large feathered SEMI-FLOPPY ears with dark folded tips (one droops a little more), a generous grey-cream throat/chest ruff. Preserve Bond's actual ear silhouette, face markings and compact build. He is not a Samoyed, Shiba, Pomeranian, fox, German shepherd, or generic tiny puppy.

ART DIRECTION: A beautifully drawn warm slice-of-life ANIME companion character with rich, deliberate fur detail. Rounded welcoming cheek forms; slightly fuller paws and expressive softened eyes, modest stylization that retains a real dog's anatomy. Variable umber linework, irregular broad tufts with fine strand accents concentrated around ears/cheeks/chest, softer low-contrast internal rendering. Controlled hand-painted warm shadow shapes, subtle lively asymmetry, matte highlights. Delicate enough to belong in an ivory family scrapbook with chocolate bookcloth, brass rules, serif typography and old family photographs. No sepia engraving, stiff colored-pencil realism, shaggy repetitive spikes, huge glass eyes, airbrushed 3D sheen, human teeth, blush stickers, collars, accessories or text.

POSE AND PERSONALITY: Bond is a cute, happy, slightly goofy boy, greeting his family with a natural small open-mouth grin and tiny relaxed pink tongue. Warm joyful eyes, relaxed brow (no sad puppy expression), soft ears, slightly cocked head. Chest up, BOTH front paws clearly resting side by side on the same invisible horizontal ledge near the bottom. Front-facing enough that both eyes can later follow a pointer. Head and paws centered, complete ears visible, at least 6% transparent padding on all sides. Square composition, cutout only with TRUE transparent background and no table drawn, no floor, no shadow outside his body. This is the MASTER watching/sign-in pose that all other website states will match. Anatomically correct two front paws.

Warm ochre-gold/tan fur, cocoa-dark muzzle and folded ear tips, grey-cream chest; these belong with chocolate bookcloth, ivory book paper and brass/gold accents. No colored-pencil scribble texture, no engraving, no pastel wash around the subject, no flat corporate vector dog, no glossy 3D modeling.

RECOGNISABLE BOND: fluffy small adult mixed-breed; actual soft broad head, black-brown muzzle, dark forehead stripe, almond-rounded expressive warm brown eyes of normal dog size, slightly scruffy dark semi-floppy feathered ears (tips fold DOWN, not straight up), cream-grey chest ruff, golden tan paws with a few dark nails. Keep Bond's face and actual markings. Do not redesign him into a fox, Shiba, Pomeranian, Samoyed or baby German shepherd.

EXPRESSION: Happy friendly cheeky boy with a relaxed joyful dog grin, a little pink tongue casually resting to one side, bright smiling eyes and a mild amused head tilt. No frown, worried eyebrows, begging sadness or solemn stare. No human teeth, human lips, oversized doll eyes or multiple wet highlights. He feels like the family’s funny familiar dog, curious about what you’re writing. Both eyes visible and directed toward viewer so they can be animated subtly. One character only, no lettering, no props, no border, no sticker outline, no drawn table, no cast shadow. True alpha outside his body, opaque fluffy fur inside.
